texts.en: [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that a strange sickness has been spreading among the [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] on [From.Planet.GetName]. The first confirmed cases appeared shortly after a sealed chamber was opened for the first time. With a large part of the team incapacitated, progress has been delayed.
